verses.en: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
verses.pt: Conjuro-te diante de Deus e de Cristo Jesus, que há de julgar os vivos e os mortos, pela sua vinda e pelo seu reino;
verses.en_web: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:
verses.en_bbe: I give you orders, before God and Christ Jesus, who will be the judge of the living and the dead, and by his revelation and his kingdom;

verses.en: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
verses.pt: prega a palavra, insta a tempo e fora de tempo, admoesta, repreende, exorta, com toda longanimidade e ensino.
verses.en_web: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort, with all patience and teaching.
verses.en_bbe: Be preaching the word at all times, in every place; make protests, say sharp words, give comfort, with long waiting and teaching;

verses.en: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
verses.pt: Porque virá tempo em que não suportarão a sã doutrina; mas, tendo grande desejo de ouvir coisas agradáveis, ajuntarão para si mestres segundo os seus próprios desejos,
verses.en_web: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but, having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts;
verses.en_bbe: For the time will come when they will not take the true teaching; but, moved by their desires, they will get for themselves a great number of teachers for the pleasure of hearing them;

verses.en: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
verses.pt: e não só desviarão os ouvidos da verdade, mas se voltarão às fábulas.
verses.en_web: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
verses.en_bbe: And shutting their ears to what is true, will be turned away to belief in foolish stories.

verses.en: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
verses.pt: Tu, porém, sê sóbrio em tudo, sofre as aflições, faze a obra de um evangelista, cumpre o teu ministério.
verses.en_web: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
verses.en_bbe: But be self-controlled in all things, do without comfort, go on preaching the good news, completing the work which has been given you to do.

verses.en: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.pt: Quanto a mim, já estou sendo derramado como libação, e o tempo da minha partida está próximo.
verses.en_web: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
verses.en_bbe: For I am even now being offered, and my end is near.

verses.en: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.pt: Combati o bom combate, acabei a carreira, guardei a fé.
verses.en_web: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
verses.en_bbe: I have made a good fight, I have come to the end of my journey, I have kept the faith:

verses.en: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verses.pt: Desde agora, a coroa da justiça me está guardada, a qual o Senhor, justo juiz, me dará naquele dia; e não somente a mim, mas também a todos os que amarem a sua vinda.
verses.en_web: From now on, there is stored up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
verses.en_bbe: From now on, the crown of righteousness is made ready for me, which the Lord, the upright judge, Will give to me at that day: and not only to me, but to all those who have had love for his revelation.

verses.en: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.pt: Procura vir ter comigo breve;
verses.en_web: Be diligent to come to me soon,
verses.en_bbe: Do your best to come to me before long:

verses.en: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
verses.pt: pois Demas me abandonou, tendo amado o mundo presente, e foi para Tessalônica, Crescente para a Galácia, Tito para a Dalmácia;
verses.en_web: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
verses.en_bbe: For Demas has gone away from me, for love of this present life, and has gone to Thessalonica: Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

verses.en: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
verses.pt: só Lucas está comigo. Toma a Marcos e traze-o contigo, porque me é muito útil para o ministério.
verses.en_web: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
verses.en_bbe: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and take him with you; for he is of use to me in the work.

verses.en: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
verses.pt: Quanto a Tíquico, enviei-o a Éfeso.
verses.en_web: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
verses.en_bbe: Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.

verses.en: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
verses.pt: Quando vieres traze a capa que deixei em Trôade, em casa de Carpo, e os livros, especialmente os pergaminhos.
verses.en_web: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come, and the books, especially the parchments.
verses.en_bbe: The coat which I did not take from Troas and which is with Carpus, get when you come, and the books, specially the papers.

verses.en: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
verses.pt: Alexandre, o latoeiro, me fez muito mal; o Senhor lhe retribuirá segundo as suas obras.
verses.en_web: Alexander, the coppersmith, did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds,
verses.en_bbe: Alexander the copper-worker did me much wrong: the Lord will give him the reward of his works:

verses.en: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
verses.pt: Tu também guarda-te dele; porque resistiu muito às nossas palavras.
verses.en_web: of whom you also must beware; for he greatly opposed our words.
verses.en_bbe: But be on the watch for him, for he was violent in his attacks on our teaching.

verses.en: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
verses.pt: Na minha primeira defesa ninguém me assistiu, antes todos me desampararam. Que isto não lhes seja imputado.
verses.en_web: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
verses.en_bbe: At my first meeting with my judges, no one took my part, but all went away from me. May it not be put to their account.

verses.en: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.pt: Mas o Senhor esteve ao meu lado e me fortaleceu, para que por mim fosse cumprida a pregação, e a ouvissem todos os gentios; e fiquei livre da boca do leão,
verses.en_web: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear; and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord was by my side and gave me strength; so that through me the news might be given out in full measure, and all the Gentiles might give ear: and I was taken out of the mouth of the lion.

verses.en: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.pt: E o Senhor me livrará de toda má obra, e me levará salvo para o seu reino celestial; a quem seja glória para todo o sempre. Amém.
verses.en_web: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom; to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will keep me safe from every evil work and will give me salvation in his kingdom in heaven: to whom be glory for ever and ever. So be it.

verses.en: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.pt: Saúda a Prisca e a áquila e à casa de Onesíforo.
verses.en_web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Prisca and Aquila and those of the house of Onesiphorus.

verses.en: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
verses.pt: Erasto ficou em Corinto; a Trófimo deixei doente em Mileto.
verses.en_web: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
verses.en_bbe: Erastus was stopping at Corinth; but Trophimus, when I last saw him was at Miletus, ill.

verses.en: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.pt: Apressa-te a vir antes do inverno. Saúdam-te åubulo, Pudente, Lino, Cláudia, e todos os irmãos.
verses.en_web: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
verses.en_bbe: Do your best to come before the winter. Eubulus sends you his love, and Pudens and Linus and Claudia, and all the brothers.

verses.en: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.pt: O Senhor seja com o teu espírito. A graça seja convosco.
verses.en_web: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.
